source.name: sp_BuildMonthlyReport

result.generatedDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dbo.sp_BuildMonthlyReport(
    p_year INT,
    p_month INT
)
RETURNS TABLE (
    customername TEXT,
    ordercount BIGINT,
    totalrevenue NUMERIC(12,2)
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Temp table usage
    CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_monthlystats (
        customerid INT,
        ordercount INT,
        totalrevenue NUMERIC(12,2)
    ) ON COMMIT DROP;

    -- Clear temp table in case it exists from previous call in same session
    TRUNCATE TABLE temp_monthlystats;

    INSERT INTO temp_monthlystats
    SELECT
        o.customerid,
        COUNT(*)::INT,
        SUM(o.totalamount)
    FROM dbo.orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.orderdate) = p_year 
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.orderdate) = p_month
    GROUP BY o.customerid;

    -- Return results joined with customer info
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        c.firstname || ' ' || c.lastname AS customername,
        ms.ordercount::BIGINT,
        ms.totalrevenue
    FROM temp_monthlystats ms
    INNER JOIN dbo.customers c ON ms.customerid = c.customerid
    ORDER BY ms.totalrevenue DESC;

    -- Temp table will be automatically dropped at transaction end
END;
$$;
assumptions: The procedure returns a result set, so it's converted to a FUNCTION returning TABLE
Parameter names prefixed with 'p_' to follow PostgreSQL conventions and avoid conflicts
COUNT(*) returns BIGINT in PostgreSQL vs INT in SQL Server
String concatenation converted from '+' to '||' operator
YEAR() and MONTH() functions converted to EXTRACT()
Temporary table converted to PostgreSQL TEMP TABLE with ON COMMIT DROP
Schema 'dbo' is assumed to exist in PostgreSQL or should be adjusted to target schema
SET NOCOUNT ON has no direct equivalent in PostgreSQL and is omitted (functions don't return row counts by default)
Explicit DROP TABLE is removed as temp table auto-drops at transaction end
